Messages.Body:
The vampire is now explicitly Sabbat. (This is an errata.)

Messages.Author: BenPeal
Messages.Body: I don't know if we've officially issued errata for Feral Spirit yet, but it's text should say "This vampire is now Ahrimane and Sabbat" instead of "This vampire is now Ahrimane (and Sabbat)". The "and Sabbat" part is no longer reminder text but is instead part of the card's effect.
